grammar.summary: 本课学习过去完成时与 glancing 现在分词伴随状语。

points.title: 过去完成时叙事
points.explanation: Tired of sleeping on the floor, he saved up for years to buy a real bed. 分词短语开头表原因。had been proud of 表"曾为之自豪"。

examples.en: The young man had been proud of his bed.
examples.cn: 这个年轻人曾为他的床感到自豪。

points.title: 现在分词作伴随状语
points.explanation: Glancing at the bits of wood and metal, the man... 分词逻辑主语与主句主语一致。

examples.en: The man picked up the pieces and carried them home.
examples.cn: 那人捡起碎片搬回了家。
